support.faqQ1: How long does a project take?
support.faqA1: Project timelines vary based on complexity. Most projects take 4–12 weeks. Your account manager will provide a detailed timeline after the kickoff meeting.
support.faqQ2: How will I receive project updates?
support.faqA2: You'll receive updates directly in your project workspace. You can also message the team anytime through the Messages section.
support.faqQ3: Can I request changes during the project?
support.faqA3: Yes. Feedback and revisions are part of our process. Your account manager will guide you through the review stages.
support.faqQ4: How do I pay for my project?
support.faqA4: Invoices are sent through the platform. You can view and pay them in the Payments section of your dashboard.
support.faqA5: Your dedicated account manager is assigned after your project kicks off. You can see their contact info in your project workspace.
support.faqQ6: What if I need urgent help?
support.faqA6: WhatsApp us directly at +201090385390. We typically respond within 30 minutes during business hours.

work1.title: Nexus Commerce
work1.description: A fast-scaling brand needed a platform that could grow without breaking. We built a headless commerce architecture with microservices, real-time inventory, and seamless ERP integration. The result: sub-second load times even at peak traffic, and a foundation built to support the next 10x of growth.

work2.title: Vault Analytics
work2.description: A B2B SaaS team needed to make complex data accessible to non-technical users without compromising depth. We architected a real-time analytics platform with custom visualizations and role-based access. Teams now make faster decisions — backed by data, secured at the enterprise level from day one.

work3.title: Aria Studio
work3.description: A distributed creative agency needed a workspace that matched the quality of their output. We built a unified collaboration platform with real-time co-editing, structured project management, and secure file workflows. Less friction, higher output, better work.
